title: Hierarchical Graph Metanetworks
abstract: arXiv:2611.34726v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The emerging field of weight space learning has demonstrated the potential to enable metanetworks, i.e. models that process neural network (NN) data, to support several steps of the machine learning lifecycle, from model optimisation to evaluation and adaptation. However, this potential has yet to materialise beyond small-scale MLPs or CNNs: most current models, including message-passing based graph metanetworks (GMNs), operate exclusively at the finest level of granularity, processing every neuron and weight of the input model. Their cost therefore scales with the number of parameters. Yet NNs are inherently organised hierarchically, with neurons forming layers and layers forming blocks and modules. Additionally, several of their properties, such as Lipschitz upper bounds and generalisation measures, are compositions of layer- and block-level quantities. translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.34726v1 公告类型：新 摘要：权重空间学习这一新兴领域已经展现出使元网络（即处理神经网络（NN）数据的模型）能够支持机器学习生命周期多个步骤的潜力，涵盖从模型优化到评估与适应。然而，这一潜力尚未在小规模MLP或CNN之外真正实现：目前的大多数模型，包括基于消息传递的图元网络（GMNs），仅在最细粒度层级上运行，处理输入模型的每一个神经元和权重，因此其成本随参数数量的增长而扩展。然而，神经网络本质上是按层次组织的：神经元构成层，层构成块和模块。此外，神经网络的若干属性，如Lipschitz上界和泛化度量，是层级别和块级别量的组合。为了将这一归纳偏置纳入模型，我们提出了层次图元网络。
tldr: 该论文提出层次图元网络（Hierarchical Graph Metanetworks），利用神经网络固有的层次结构（神经元—层—块/模块）作为归纳偏置，突破了现有图元网络只能在最细粒度处理每个神经元和权重、计算成本随参数量扩展的瓶颈，从而实现高效的大规模神经网络权重空间学习。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Hierarchical Graph Metanetworks, which leverage the inherent hierarchical organization of neural networks (neurons-layers-blocks) as an inductive bias, overcoming the limitation of existing graph metanetworks that operate at the finest granularity with costs scaling with parameter count, thereby enabling efficient weight space learning on large-scale neural networks.
